title: MyPatientPal+: A Smartphone App and a Provider Dashboard to Manage Patient Care While on Treatment
official: MyPatientPal+: A Smartphone App and a Provider Dashboard to Manage Patient Care While on Treatment
summary: The overall goal of this clinical trial is to assess the feasibility of implementing MyPatientPal+ a smartphone app and provider dashboard, to collect daily patient-reported outcome data from patients and share with providers to improve the effective management of treatment-related side effects
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Patients-

* 18-70 Years of age
* have a diagnosis of breast, any gastrointestinal, lung, prostate, head and neck, or bladder cancer
* about to initiate chemotherapy using one of the regimens listed in the protocol
* be able to speak, read, and write English
* willing and able to provide consent
* have access to a stable internet connection

Providers:

* being a practicing oncologist
* treating patients at Karmanos Cancer Institute (KCI) who are enrolled and consent to using the MyPatientPal+ smartphone app
* provide consent for the study

Exclusion Criteria:

Patients-

* cognitive or perceptual disturbances that prevent completing study measures Provider-
* None
